senses.gloss: (b. h. פָּשַׂע; cmp. פָּסָה a. פָּסַח) [to spread the feet,] to step out, walk.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 27b:23">Meg. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>לא פָסַעְתִּי על ראשי וכ׳</he> I never strode over the heads of the holy people (never forced my way through the students seated on the floor to reach my chair); <cite ref="Sanhedrin 7b:12">Snh. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>מניין לדיין שלא יִפְסַע וכ׳</he> where is it intimated that a judge must not force his way &c. (Answ. by ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 20:26">Ex. XX, 26</cite>, sq.); <cite ref="Yevamot 105b:10">Yeb. 105ᵇ</cite> <he>מי שצריך … יִפְסַע וכ׳</he> he of whom the holy people are in need, may step over the heads &c.
<cite ref="Sotah 13b:17">Sot. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>שתים … ופְסָעָן משה בפסיעה אחת</he> twelve steps were there, and Moses passed over them with one step.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 99:6">Gen. R. s. 99</cite> (play on <he>פ̇ח̇ז</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 49:4">Gen. XLIX, 4</cite>) <he>פָּסַעְתָּ על דת ח̇ללת … ז̇ר</he> thou didst overstep (transgress) the law, desecrate thy birthright (priesthood), and hast become a commoner. Mekh. Bo 7 (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 12:13">Ex. XII, 13</cite>) <he>א״ת ופסחתי אלא וּפָסַעְתִּי וכ׳</he> read not, and I will pass, but I will step over (leap, skip), the Lord skipped over &c.; a. e.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="Q01340">same</cite>. Y. Kil. VI, 30ᶜ <he>לפַסֵּעַ</he>, v. <cite ref="Q00779"><he>פֵּיפוּר</he></cite>. Yeb. l. c. <he>מי הוא זה שמְפַסֵּעַ על ראשי וכ׳</he> who is he that forces his way over the heads &c.?, v. supra; a. e.

units: <cite ref="Horayot 13b:7">Hor. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>בזמן שרבים … מַפְסִיעִין על וכ׳</he> when the public need their services, they may force their way &c.
<cite ref="Taanit 10b:10">Taan. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>אל תַּפְסִיעוּ פסיעה גסה וכ׳</he> never march with hasty steps, and bring the sun into town (enter before sunset); a. e.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 10a">M. Kat. 10ᵃ</cite>; Y. ib. I, 80ᵈ bot., v. <cite ref="K00676"><he>כָּלַב</he></cite>.
